questions.question: What parable does Ezekiel give on the day Babylon besieged Jerusalem in chapter 24?
options: The valley of the dry bones
The two dry sticks joined together into one

questions.question: What deeply personal sign did Ezekiel experience in chapter 24?
options: His wife died, and he was told not to mourn, as a sign
He went suddenly deaf and could hear nothing at all
He was struck blind for the whole long length of the siege
His house was burned with everything that he owned
questions.answer: His wife died, and he was told not to mourn, as a sign

questions.question: Ezekiel's not mourning was a sign that the people would not mourn openly when the temple fell.
Behold, I am about to take the delight of your eyes away from you at a stroke; yet you shall not _____.
